Chief_Complaint.content: Cough and constant rhinorrhea for 5 days

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Dry cough described as quite bad, occurring every 20–30 minutes
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Dry cough, “quite bad”; coughing q20–30 min

History_of_Present_Illness.content: No phlegm with the cough
Constant rhinorrhea with pretty green nasal discharge
Feeling hot with chills and possible fever, not checked with thermometer
Myalgias present
Diarrhoea occurred at onset of illness and has resolved
Using Lemsip 2–3 times per day which helps soothe throat at night
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Lemsip 2–3/day; helps soothe throat at night

History_of_Present_Illness.content: No chest pain
No shortness of breath and no pleuritic pain
No hemoptysis
No epistaxis
No sinus pain or congestion
No sore ears and sore throat not endorsed; throat comfort improved with Lemsip
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: No sore ears; sore throat not endorsed (Lemsip helps throat)

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Eating and drinking are okay and patient is tolerating fluids
Passing urine is okay with no increased frequency and no polydipsia
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Passing urine OK; no ↑frequency; no polydipsia

History_of_Present_Illness.content: No vomiting and no current diarrhoea
No rash
No headache and no vision change
No history of recurrent chest infections
No baseline wheeze or shortness of breath except with intense exercise
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: No baseline wheeze/SOB (only with intense exercise)

Medications.content: Lisinopril is being taken; patient thinks dose is 200
Lemsip taken 2–3 times per day for current illness
Medications.source_text: Lemsip 2–3/day; helps soothe throat at night

Adverse_Drug_Reactions_and_Allergies.content: No known drug allergies; patient not aware of medication allergies
Adverse_Drug_Reactions_and_Allergies.source_text: NKDA (pt not aware of med allergies)

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient drinks alcohol described as an odd cherry
Patient lives with partner and dog
Patient works as an office manager

Assessment.content: Acute cough and upper respiratory infection symptoms for 5 days with dry cough, green rhinorrhea, hot/chills, and myalgias, without shortness of breath, chest pain, or hemoptysis; likely viral; to be monitored given diabetes mellitus
Assessment.source_text: 1. **Acute cough + URI sx x5 days** – dry cough, green rhinorrhea, hot/chills, myalgias; no SOB/CP/hemoptysis; likely viral; monitor given DM.

Assessment.content: Diabetes mellitus with higher risk of bacterial infection; patient does not have blood sugar checking equipment currently
Assessment.source_text: 2. **DM** – higher risk bacterial infection; pt does not have BS checking equipment currently.

Assessment.content: Hypertension on lisinopril; blood pressure not recently checked and stability unknown
Assessment.source_text: 3. **HTN** – on lisinopril; BP not recently checked/unknown stability.

Plan_of_Care.content: For acute cough and URI, obtain a thermometer and check temperature
For acute cough and URI, continue supportive care with Lemsip
Avoid additional paracetamol-containing products while taking Lemsip
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Avoid additional paracetamol-containing products while taking Lemsip

Plan_of_Care.content: Cough syrup to be avoided during daytime; may use a small amount at night if unable to sleep
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Cough syrup: avoid daytime; may use small amount at night if unable to sleep

Plan_of_Care.content: Safety-net advice: if persistent fever greater than 37.5–38C, worsening cough, increasing or phlegmy sputum, hemoptysis, epistaxis, shortness of breath, or chest pain, seek review and consider antibiotics if not settling or worsening, especially given diabetes mellitus
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Safety-net/return precautions: persistent fever >37.5–38C, worsening cough, increasing/phlegmy sputum, hemoptysis, epistaxis, SOB, CP → seek review; consider abx if not settling/worsening esp given DM

Plan_of_Care.content: For diabetes mellitus, ensure regular diabetes check-ups as per GP
